title: Agent SDK: the Agent as a Library

points.text: The Agent SDK exposes the Claude Code loop from Python or TypeScript: built-in Read, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, and web-search tools, plus MCP servers, hooks, skills, subagents, and sessions.
